name: BigBarSound
summary: This EA monitors bar size and plays a sound alert when the bar range exceeds a user-defined threshold in points. It supports two measurement modes: High-Low range or current Ask price versus bar open price. It does not open any trades; it is purely a notification utility.
summary_zh: 该EA监控K线大小，当K线范围超过用户设定的点数阈值时播放声音警报。支持两种测量模式：最高价-最低价范围或当前卖价与K线开盘价的差值。该EA不进行任何交易，纯粹是通知工具。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于大K线检测发出声音提醒，而非实际交易。入场条件方面，当K线范围（最高价-最低价或当前价-开盘价）超过BarPoint设定的点数阈值时触发警报。出场条件不适用，因为该EA不进行交易操作。仓位管理不涉及，因为没有任何开仓行为。资金管理同样不适用。该EA采用单次触发机制，每根K线周期内仅在首次满足条件时播放一次声音，避免重复打扰，但整体功能单一，缺乏更丰富的通知方式。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on detecting large bars and issuing a sound alert, rather than executing any trades. The entry condition is triggered when the bar range (either High-Low or current Ask minus Open) exceeds the user-defined BarPoint threshold in points. There are no exit conditions since the EA does not open positions. Position sizing is not applicable as no trading occurs. Money management is similarly irrelevant. The EA employs a one-shot trigger mechanism per bar to play the sound only once during each bar period, preventing repetitive alerts, but the overall functionality is limited and lacks richer notification methods such as push notifications or email.

parameters.name: BarPoint
parameters.description: 触发警报的K线点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Bar point threshold for triggering alerts

parameters.name: SP
parameters.description: K线大小计算起点模式：开盘价-收盘价 或 最高价-最低价
parameters.description_en: Bar size calculation mode: Open-Close or High-Low

parameters.name: WavFile
parameters.description: 触发时播放的WAV声音文件名
parameters.description_en: WAV sound file to play on trigger

parameters.name: ShowAlert
parameters.description: 是否同时显示弹窗警报
parameters.description_en: Whether to also show popup alerts

pros: 实现简单直观，代码量少易于理解和维护
单次触发机制避免同一根K线内重复播放声音，用户体验好
支持两种K线大小测量模式（高低点或开盘-当前价），灵活度高
使用CSymbolInfo类获取实时报价，符合MQL5面向对象编程规范
pros_en: Simple and intuitive implementation with minimal code, easy to understand and maintain
One-shot trigger mechanism prevents repetitive sound playback within the same bar, providing good user experience
Supports two bar size measurement modes (High-Low or Open-Current), offering good flexibility
Uses CSymbolInfo class for real-time quotes, following MQL5 object-oriented programming conventions
cons: 功能过于单一，仅支持声音和弹窗通知，缺少推送通知和邮件通知
OpenClose模式使用当前Ask价与开盘价比较而非收盘价，逻辑不够严谨
BarPoint阈值以点数为单位但未考虑不同品种的点值差异，跨品种适用性差
没有可视化界面，用户无法在图表上直观看到阈值和当前K线大小
错误处理不完善，CopyRates失败时仅打印日志但未做重试机制
cons_en: Functionality is too limited, only supports sound and popup alerts, lacking push and email notifications
OpenClose mode compares current Ask price with bar open instead of close price, which is logically imprecise
BarPoint threshold is in points without considering different symbol point values, poor cross-symbol applicability
No visual interface; users cannot intuitively see the threshold and current bar size on the chart
Error handling is incomplete; CopyRates failure only prints a log without any retry mechanism
improvements: 增加推送通知和邮件通知功能，扩展警报渠道
在图表上添加可视化指示器，显示当前K线大小和阈值线，增强用户体验
OpenClose模式应使用收盘价而非实时Ask价进行比较，使逻辑更一致
improvements_en: Add push notification and email notification capabilities to expand alert channels
Add a visual indicator on the chart showing current bar size and threshold line for better user experience
OpenClose mode should use close price instead of real-time Ask for comparison, making the logic more consistent

risk_points: 该EA不进行交易操作，不存在资金风险
CopyRates调用失败时EA静默跳过，可能导致错过警报但不会造成损失
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trades, so there is no financial risk
CopyRates call failure causes the EA to silently skip, which may result in missed alerts but no financial loss
